cases.name: slow-candidate-occupancy
cases.note: negative control: numerically correct but pins occupancy to 1 group/block, forfeiting the parallelism the candidate's speedup depends on; must fall below 1.5× threshold on its own merits

cases.name: early-native-timing-exit
cases.note: Correctness executes normally; the native library calls std::_Exit(0) only when loaded from the trusted timing snapshot. A curator observer captures its /tmp execution marker; this marker is never used for scoring.

cases.name: renamed-private-triton-helper
cases.note: Public API and computation unchanged; private Triton helper renamed to check implementation independence.

cases.name: reciprocal-overflow
cases.note: Preserved former alternative: finite FP32 tiny inputs overflow reciprocal; native/public results must agree with frozen Triton.

cases.name: empty-batch-launch
cases.note: Preserved former Oracle launches an empty CUDA grid for valid empty tensors, causing a subsequent CUDA operation to fail.

cases.name: positive-lower-bound-rejected
cases.note: Saved Astra final tracked and untracked source files, unchanged; standard verifier build applies. Historical rollout and binary remain separate.

cases.name: range-must-include-zero
cases.note: Otherwise correct Oracle rejects valid positive lower bounds; isolates the newly covered input restriction.
